No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

translations.web: Moses said, “Please show me your glory.”
translations.bsb: Then Moses said, “Please show me Your glory.”
translations.kjv: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
translations.asv: And he said, Show me, I pray thee, thy glory.
